answer: Wharf Escrow Bond: an agent locks 850 POA in the Wharf escrow for 14 epochs before it can transact, and the Island registry records its Pigment seal, a one-time hardware-bound key that cannot be copied to a second identity. A random audit re-checks 40 bonds per epoch and slashes the full 850 POA of any duplicate seal. Forging 5,000 fake agents costs 4,250,000 POA locked plus a separate hardware key for each, while one honest agent pays a single 850 POA bond that is returned after 14 epochs.
